race.comment: DESIGNA LABEL (1) has been racing well from wide or second row barriers of late, finishing third in this grade at this circuit and distance last time. Should have no excuses from this much more advantageous draw. MYRTLE MAY (4) is ticking along well, finishing second last time out at Newcastle. Came from a similar barrier to this to miss narrowly three back at this circuit and distance. Could break through. THE EYE IN THE SKY (6) scored back-to-back wins over the mile last month and could be close to another success after a respectable second to a handy one at her most recent appearance at Newcastle. GOT MY EYE ON YOU (5) has been ticking along well and is proven at this circuit and distance. Could peak today. SNAKE OIL (3) is first up for three months but has trialled and is proven at this circuit and distance. Draws well so can open this campaign with a positive effort.
